name: Base excision repair from glycosylase cleavage to gap filling
rationale: All members are steps of base excision repair, from glycosylase recognition and cleavage of damaged purines/pyrimidines to short- and long-patch gap filling, which the confusables (defective glycosylases, SSB repair, alkylation reversal) lack.

name: S-phase DNA replication control and damage checkpoint response
rationale: Members cover replication initiation and its restraint, E2F1 targets, intra-S checkpoint signalling and response, p53-driven repair genes and recombination-intermediate resolution, distinguishing it from ATR-activation and unwinding/break-induced replication neighbours.

name: Phenylalanine–tyrosine catabolism and general amino acid metabolism
rationale: Specific members concern phenylalanine/tyrosine breakdown and phenylketonuria, with broad amino/organic acid parent terms; it lacks the BH4 cofactor, aromatic acid conjugation and other amino acids of its neighbours.

qualifier: positive regulation in NK and T cells
name: Positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: All three members are positive regulation of NK or T cell killing, while confusables hold negative regulation, NK/T cell signatures and degranulation.

name: Reactive oxygen detoxification and isocitrate-linked NADPH supply
rationale: Members combine ROS/hydroperoxide/superoxide handling and redox homeostasis with NADPH/NADP+ generation, isocitrate and 2-hydroxyglutarate metabolism, lacking the aldehyde, ascorbate and ferroptosis content of neighbours.

name: Urea cycle ammonia detoxification and inherited enzyme defects
rationale: Members are urea cycle steps, arginine/citrulline/ornithine metabolism, ammonium homeostasis and CPS1/OTC/ASS1/ASL/ARG1/NAGS deficiencies, which the glutamate/aspartate and cationic amino acid transport neighbours lack.

name: Cholesterol catabolism to bile acids
rationale: All members describe conversion of cholesterol via hydroxycholesterols to bile acids (including CTX), versus neighbours covering cholesterol biosynthesis, bile acid transport/signalling or spastic paraplegia defects.

name: Collagen–elastic fibre assembly and promotion of matrix secretion
rationale: Members cover collagen synthesis, fibril crosslinking, elastic fibres and arterial tortuosity, plus positive regulation of ECM secretion, proteoglycan synthesis and endothelial-matrix adhesion that neighbours lack.

name: Polyamine metabolism and transport, including eIF5A hypusination
rationale: Most members concern putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, interconversion, ODC regulation and transport plus spermidine-dependent eIF5A hypusination, without the tryptophan/NAD, methionine salvage or protein methylation/hydroxylation of neighbours.

qualifier: activated dendritic and Th1 T cells
name: Activated dendritic cell and Th1 T cell surface signatures
rationale: Members are surface signatures of LPS-activated DCs and Th1-stimulated CD4 T cells with butyrophilin interactions, whereas confusables are resting DC and monocyte signatures.

name: Solute-carrier ion exchangers and cotransporters, with inherited defects
rationale: Members are SLC4/9/12/26 chloride, bicarbonate, sodium-proton and inorganic anion transporters and their disease variants, unlike the CFTR/aquaporin, carbonic anhydrase and synaptic neighbours.

name: Gastrointestinal and urinary smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members concern smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, peristalsis, gastric function and micturition, distinguishing it from serotonin, histamine and reproductive smooth muscle neighbours.

name: Replication stress response to fork-stalling lesions
rationale: Members cover responses to camptothecin and hydroxyurea, fork reversal, R-loop and DNA-protein crosslink processing and checkpoint signalling, unlike the telomere, DNA topology and recombination-repair neighbours.

name: Actin filament dynamics driving filopodia, ruffles and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing, capping and crosslinking for protrusions and motility, without the Rho GTPase cycles, WASP/WAVE activation or focal adhesion content of neighbours.

name: COPI-mediated and retrograde Golgi membrane traffic
rationale: Members are COPI vesicle budding, intra-Golgi, Golgi-to-ER and endosome/TGN-to-Golgi retrograde traffic, unlike neighbours focused on Golgi-to-lysosome/endosome transport.

name: BDNF–TrkB signalling and postsynaptic receptor trafficking
rationale: Members combine BDNF/NTRK2 signalling with AMPA and neurotransmitter receptor trafficking at the postsynapse, which separates it from actin/dendrite, plasticity and presynaptic neighbours.

qualifier: Notch O-fucose/glucose and N-glycan glucose trimming
name: Notch O-fucosylation/glucosylation and ER N-glycan trimming
rationale: Members cover O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins and glucose-linked N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1, Dol-P-Glc), unlike GAG, CDG and lysosomal storage neighbours.

name: Locomotor, vocal and sensorimotor behaviour
rationale: Members are locomotion, vocalization and vocal learning, proprioception, reflexes and auditory/mechanosensory behaviour with striatal and cerebellar development, distinct from exploration/grooming and glycinergic neighbours.

name: Ubiquitin-mediated protein quality control with atypical chain linkages
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein handling, ERAD and degron pathways plus K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched ubiquitination and DUBs, which neighbours lack in favour of proteasome and K48 regulation.

name: Myoblast commitment, proliferation, differentiation and fusion
rationale: All members regulate myoblast fate, proliferation, migration, differentiation and fusion, whereas neighbours centre on satellite cells, regeneration and muscle fibre differentiation.

name: Nephric duct, mesonephros and ureter morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern nephric duct formation, mesonephros and ureter/epithelial tube development, unlike neighbours on ureteric bud branching, metanephros and nephron patterning.

name: Protein SUMOylation and regulation of nucleocytoplasmic protein transport
rationale: Members are the SUMO conjugation cycle and its targets (including viral nucleoproteins) plus regulation of nuclear import/export, without the nuclear pore, envelope or PML body content of neighbours.

name: Cotranslational protein targeting to and retention in ER
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent targeting, membrane insertion, ER localization and retention, versus neighbours on COPI/COPII vesicle traffic and ERAD.

name: Dermatan sulfate-degrading mucopolysaccharidoses: Hurler, Hunter, Maroteaux-Lamy
rationale: All members are MPS I, II and VI, the enzyme defects in dermatan sulfate breakdown, while neighbours hold Sanfilippo, Morquio and general GAG degradation.

name: Rab GAP and ARF regulation of synaptic endosomal trafficking
rationale: Members pair TBC/Rab GAP, Rab and ARF signalling with postsynaptic receptor internalization and endosomal vesicle recycling, unlike neighbours on Rab GEF/prenylation, AMPA trafficking or presynaptic structure.
